direction.camera: Guide attention with smoke volume; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: allow one soft volume to reveal an anchored silhouette; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with soft silhouette; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with quiet emergence.
direction.lighting: backlit smoke glow; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: fine vapor and matte dark stone; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around low key; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use smoke volume,soft silhouette,airy depth,slow curl,low key,quiet emergence as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
